title: catalyst identity status
description: The provider the deployment points at (IAM/identity.json, design 29), whether this machine holds a person's tokens for it, and, from those tokens' expiry alone (no network), the state of that session.

logged_in.description: Tokens for this provider are stored on this machine, valid or not.

session.description: `active`: the access token is valid; `refreshable`: it expired and the refresh token has not (the next use refreshes it); `expired`: both expired, the session lapsed and the system account signs instead (`catalyst identity login`); `none`: no tokens stored.

verified.description: Whether the provider confirmed the stored login just now (a network check, made only when tokens are stored and the provider is reachable). `yes`: the provider named the person (`username`); `no`: the provider refused the stored login (lapsed, revoked, or rejected by the provider); `unreachable`: the provider could not be asked, or its answer was not understood, so the offline `session` stands; `not_checked`: no tokens are stored, so there was nothing to check.

username.description: The person the provider named, present only when `verified` is `yes`.
